svg.title: Control & Audit Data Model — Microsoft Fabric SQL Database
svg.desc: Editable Fabric SQL Database control and audit ER diagram. Relationships: connection settings to ingestion config (two enforced one-to-many FKs); ingestion config to pipeline watermarks (enforced one-to-zero-or-one); ingestion config to ingestion log (optional logical zero-to-many, not FK-enforced). Crow foot symbols convey cardinality without numeric labels.

g.text: Reusable references for source and target connections
Defines source, target, and load behavior
Tracks the latest incremental processing position
Stores terminal status and execution metrics

svg.text: Source and target both resolve through
Each config can have at most one record

g.text: References must match an existing parent row
Audit references may be null or unmatched
